scope: Corollary D.5 (Bounded-multiple character regularization) of the manuscript “Uniform Cartier sections for Fano type contractions” (preprints/Uniform-Cartier-sections-for-Fano-type-contractions-September-25-2026/Uniform-Cartier-sections-for-Fano-type-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d97ba60373419ba), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 59. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that the order condition (C.5) on Vu, with error ηi → 0, holds whenever a(P) = 0 and LD(P) → 0. Fix C0 > 0. If k ∈ M satisfies |⟨y, k⟩| ≤ C0L⟨y, u⟩ (y ∈ σ), (D.18) there are a bounded positive integer q, a nonzero invariant rational eigenfunction Y = fzqk, and a positive integer b ≤ C2L such that hbY ∈ R̆. The constants are uniform in k. Both signs of k may be treated with the same bounded multiplier, and their costs may be increased to a common cost O(L). The same bounds hold uniformly if L is replaced by any L′ ≥ L and (D.18) is imposed at scale L′.
